h: Atiku criticises reports of security agents guarding Tinubu's campaign banners in Kaduna
p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly taken aim at President Tinubu over claims that security personnel were deployed to protect campaign materials in Kaduna ahead of the APC flag-off. The APC has pledged a strong turnout for Saturday's launch.
more: Atiku's camp has also called the 90-day cost-of-living plan 'election bait'.
The Tinubu camp has not commented on the banner claim.
